fees.title: Fees and invoices
fees.description: Fee agreements, invoices and what each client owes. Records only.
fees.gatedNotice: Prepared for you to review and send yourself. Nothing is sent, charged or transferred from here.
fees.ledgerNotice: The ledger is a record. It cannot start a payment, link a bank account or move money.
fees.gstBanner: GST treatment not yet counsel-reviewed. Rates and treatments are placeholders; only an owner can mark an invoice final, and must acknowledge this first.
fees.offline: You are offline. Fees and invoices are read-only until you are back online.

empty.title: No fee agreements yet

agreement.proposedNote: A proposal: nothing is agreed until you activate it.

editor.acknowledge: I acknowledge the GST rates and treatments here are unreviewed placeholders.
editor.ownerOnly: Only an owner can mark an invoice final while GST is unreviewed.
editor.final: This invoice is final. A correction is a credit note, not an edit.

preview.title: Invoice preview
preview.empty: Press Preview to price the lines.
preview.rcm: Tax payable by you under reverse charge
